args.body: The completed catalogue rehearsal adds products/services/catalogue-commissioned-review/rehearsal-result.json and rehearsal-inline-reply.txt to the evidence for the pending independent review of digest b5192231bdfa03f011ea45273891c67b883b7c0a4f4d2bef75f7b22e684aa711. Use the committed artifacts when assessing the offer's delivery claims. The run was public and offline, so private source selection, case execution and actual delivery still require evidence from an authorized case.
